entities.name: IP header compression
entities.description: Robust header compression (ROHC) framework for IP header compression in control plane CIoT EPS optimization for PDN connections of IP PDN type.

entities.name: ROHC framework
entities.description: Robust header compression framework as defined in IETF RFC 5795, used for IP header compression.

entities.name: ROHC profiles
entities.description: ROHC profiles defined in 3GPP TS 36.323 that may be supported for IP header compression.

entities.name: UE requested PDN connectivity procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which ROHC configuration is negotiated and established.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which UE and MME indicate support for IP header compression.

entities.name: Tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which UE and MME indicate support for IP header compression.

entities.name: UE requested bearer resource modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure that can be used to re-negotiate ROHC configuration.

entities.name: EPS bearer context modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure that can be used to re-negotiate ROHC configuration.

relations.description: IP header compression uses ROHC framework for compression.
IP header compression may use ROHC profiles defined in TS 36.323.
ROHC configuration is negotiated and established during UE requested PDN connectivity procedure.
UE and MME indicate support for IP header compression during attach procedure.
UE and MME indicate support for IP header compression during tracking area updating procedure.
ROHC configuration can be re-negotiated using UE requested bearer resource modification procedure.
ROHC configuration can be re-negotiated using EPS bearer context modification procedure.
